message.reasoning: Okay, so I'm trying to figure out whether it's right or wrong for me to have told this girl about her boyfriend cheating on her with me. Let me start by understanding the situation better. So, I was the "side chick," which means I was in a relationship with someone who was also seeing another person. I didn't know about this until he felt guilty enough to tell me. It was a one-time thing, but still, it hurt. This happened a month ago, but I just found out who she is through a mutual coworker. I messaged her just trying to look out for another girl, but it completely backfired. I sent screenshots and told her what happened, saying she deserved better. She responded by basically saying they had already discussed it and that I should never contact her again. It was really rude. Now, I'm wondering if I should have said anything at all. I thought I was doing the right thing because I wanted to know if my boyfriend was cheating, but now I feel dumb that I even brought it back up since she said they were over it. I guess I need to think about why I did what I did. I wanted to protect myself and maybe her from getting hurt again. But by contacting her, I might have caused more pain or disrupted whatever peace they had. Maybe I should have kept it to myself or talked to someone else about it instead of reaching out to her. I don't know if it's right or wrong, but I feel like I overstepped by contacting her, especially since she told me not to contact her again. I also wonder about the consequences of my actions. Did I make things worse for her? Did I make myself look bad? I think I should have respected her space and not interfered. In the end, I think it might have been wrong to contact her because it brought up old wounds and made things uncomfortable for both of us. I should have handled it differently, maybe by talking to my boyfriend or just letting it go instead of involving her.
